declaration.preface: OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD, incorporated on February 10, 2006, is dedicated to designing and manufacturing hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic steering systems for off-highway vehicles, automotive, and marine applications. We are committed to ensuring that our employment practices contribute to the well-being of our employees and the communities in which we operate. This policy outlines our commitment to providing a living wage to all our employees and promoting fair compensation practices throughout our supply chain.
declaration.declaration: Ognibene India Pvt. Ltd. is committed to ensuring that all employees receive a living wage that enables them to meet their basic needs and those of their families. We aim to promote fair compensation practices throughout our organization and supply chain while balancing economic sustainability with social responsibility.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all workers, employees, directors, officers, agents, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD (OIL). It covers all business activities, including employment, procurement, and any interactions with government officials, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. The policy is applicable globally, regardless of local business practices or cultural norms. This policy applies to the following locations:

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
A living wage that enables them to meet their basic needs and those of their families.

100% of direct employees receive a living wage, as calculated for their specific location and family size.

Conduct biannual reviews of our wage structure to ensure it keeps pace with the changing cost of living.

By 2030, we aim for 100% of employees to receive inflation-adjusted salary revisions within six months of any market cost increase.

The policy applies to all workers, employees, directors, officers, agents, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of OGNIBENE INDIA PVT LTD (OIL).

By 2030, Ognibene India provides 100% medical insurance and retirement coverage for all permanent employees.

Living Wage Implementation: Fair compensation awareness improves by 15% annually through structured workshops, training programs, and internal communication campaigns.
Regular Wage Reviews: Conduct biannual reviews of our wage structure to ensure it keeps pace with the changing cost of living.
By introducing automated benchmarking tools, we ensure zero cases of delayed wage adjustments by 2030.
Employee Benefits: We aim to enhance total employee well-being beyond wages.
By introducing a “Family Support Fund,” the company support 50 employee families annually for health, education, or emergency needs.
Wage Transparency: We maintain a transparent wage structure and provides employees clear visibility on pay bands and growth opportunities.
Training and Development: We invest in employee capability building.

targets.target: By 2030, ensure that 100% of direct employees receive a living wage, as calculated for their specific location and family size.
Fair compensation awareness improves by 15% annually.
By 2030, we aim for 100% of employees to receive inflation-adjusted salary revisions within six months of any market cost increase.
By introducing automated benchmarking tools, we ensure zero cases of delayed wage adjustments by 2030.
By 2030, Ognibene India provides 100% medical insurance and retirement coverage for all permanent employees.
Ensures 80% participation in voluntary wellness and preventive health programs.
The company support 50 employee families annually for health, education, or emergency needs through a “Family Support Fund.”
Internal surveys demonstrate 100% employee satisfaction on pay fairness.
The company achieves zero wage-related grievances by 2030.
Ensuring 85% of employees complete skill development programs annually.
At least 40% of trained employees achieve role upgrades or pay increases based on performance.
Cross-functional learning contributes to 25% of total training hours.
Maintaining a maximum 15:1 ratio between the highest and lowest paid employees.
The gender pay gap remains at 0% unexplained variance.
Annual equity assessments enhance pay transparency awareness by 30% across the organization.

policy.monitoring:
The Compensation and Benefits Manager will conduct regular wage analyses and adjustments to ensure compliance with the outlined standards.

The Sustainability Manager will collaborate with suppliers to promote fair wage practices, provide necessary guidance, and track progress toward achieving the quantitative targets outlined in the policy.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed bi-annually by the Human Resources Officer (HRO), Sustainability Manager, and Finance Director to ensure it remains current with evolving economic conditions, living wage calculations, and industry best practices. Necessary updates will be communicated to all stakeholders, and any required changes will be implemented promptly.
